description: Writes the block that closes what is written from an address. It belongs to the address, so everyone who writes from it signs the same way; it is put into a message when one is being written, not added behind the sender back.

address.description: The address to sign for, from list_sender_addresses.

signature.description: The signature itself, plain text, up to 2000 characters. An empty text removes it.

name: set_signature
title: Set the signature of an address
